scripts.test: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); const assert = (condition, message) => { if (!condition) throw new Error(message); }; const assertKeys = (actual, expected, field) => assert(JSON.stringify(Object.keys(actual ?? {}).sort()) === JSON.stringify(expected), field + ' keys must match'); assertKeys(pkg.dependencies, [], 'dependencies'); assertKeys(pkg.peerDependencies, [], 'peerDependencies'); assertKeys(pkg.optionalDependencies, [], 'optionalDependencies');"
